svg.title: Replay checks which commands, in which order, never their values
svg.desc: Left, what replay compares: the command type, the activity ID and the timer ID, command by command, and the activity type once the whole history has replayed; under it, changes that fail replay. Right, what it never compares: durations, inputs, options and results; under it, changes that replay clean. Of the nine changes, five replay clean and four fail with TMPRL1100. Sources: docs/img/src/replay-compared.txt, internal/health/changes_test.go, internal/health/replay_test.go.
svg.text: Replay checks which commands, in which order, never their values
